title: 伺服电机定子绕组：槽极配合与绕组排布
title_en: Servo-motor stator winding: slot/pole combination and layout
summary: 给 200 W 伺服电机选槽数和极数：比较四种槽极配合的绕组系数、谐波、齿槽转矩阶次和单边磁拉力，排出 10 极 12 槽的集中绕组，再在定子测试台测 20 只定子。
summary_en: Choosing slots and poles for a 200 W servo motor: four slot/pole combinations compared on winding factor, harmonics, cogging order and unbalanced magnetic pull; the 10-pole 12-slot concentrated winding laid out; 20 stators tested.
honest: 示例设计：经计算和仿真校核，没有实物试制；数值为示例值。
honest_en: Example design: checked by calculation and simulation, not built and tested; all values are examples.

steps.title: 任务书
steps.summary: 200 W、3000 r/min、48 V 驱动；反电势 THD ≤ 5 %、齿槽转矩 ≤ 2.5 %；齿上直接绕的集中绕组。
steps.summary_en: 200 W, 3000 rpm, 48 V drive; back-EMF THD ≤ 5 %, cogging ≤ 2.5 %; concentrated windings wound on the teeth.

steps.title: 方案
steps.summary: 四种槽极配合比较：12/8 谐波大，9/8 有单边磁拉力，12/14 电频率高；选 12 槽 10 极（k_w1 = 0.933，5、7 次 0.067）。
steps.summary_en: Four combinations compared: 12/8 has large harmonics, 9/8 unbalanced pull, 12/14 high electrical frequency; 12-slot 10-pole chosen (k_w1 = 0.933, 5th/7th 0.067).

steps.title: 计算
steps.summary: 槽距电角 150°；排布 A −A −B B C −C −A A B −B −C C；k_w1 = 0.933（k_p 0.966 × k_d 0.966）。
steps.summary_en: Slot pitch 150° electrical; layout A −A −B B C −C −A A B −B −C C; k_w1 = 0.933 (k_p 0.966 × k_d 0.966).

figs.caption: 线圈电势星形图与各次绕组系数
figs.caption_en: Coil EMF star and harmonic winding factors

steps.title: 仿真
steps.summary: 同一个终检函数：好电机齿槽转矩 1.25 %、THD 2.24 %；磁钢贴歪后齿槽转矩 2.42 %。
steps.summary_en: Same test-bench function: a good motor shows 1.25 % cogging and 2.24 % THD; with misplaced magnets cogging rises to 2.42 %.

figs.caption: 三相反电势；齿槽转矩（好 / 磁钢贴歪）
figs.caption_en: Three-phase back-EMF; cogging torque (good / misplaced magnets)

steps.title: 三维与图纸
steps.summary: 展开绕组图、每相四个线圈串联、星形连接。
steps.summary_en: Developed winding diagram, four coils in series per phase, star connection.

steps.title: 工艺
steps.summary: 定子 6 道工序；绕线按绕组图、浸漆一炉 24 只；测试三项。
steps.summary_en: Six stator operations; winding per the diagram, varnish 24 per batch; three tests.

steps.title: 制造
steps.summary: 20 只定子三项测试，不合格 0 个，最低 Cpk 1.95。
steps.summary_en: 20 stators, three tests, 0 out of tolerance, lowest Cpk 1.95.
